sentiment.rationale: The document reports a solid quarter with comparable sales up 1.1% and adjusted EPS up 5.6% year-over-year, but full-year guidance was only updated to reflect the ADG acquisition and was not raised organically. Management expresses confidence in long-term strategy and the FBM acquisition, but the forward outlook for the core business remains unchanged with a flat home improvement market assumption. The score reflects genuine operational momentum and confident forward language, but no formal guidance raise, placing it in the +0.15 to +0.3 range.

summary.revenue: Q2 sales of $24.0 billion, comparable sales up 1.1%.
summary.eps: Adjusted diluted EPS of $4.33, an increase of 5.6% over last year.
summary.guidance: Full year 2025 sales range of $84.5 billion to $85.5 billion, comparable sales flat to up 1%, adjusted operating margin 12.2% to 12.3%, adjusted diluted EPS approximately $12.20 to $12.45. This outlook does not include FBM acquisition impacts.
summary.margin: Adjusted gross margin 33.8%, up 37 basis points from last year. Adjusted operating margin 14.7%, up 23 basis points versus prior year.
key_risks: Elevated mortgage rates and cautious consumer, affordability pressure, depressed housing market.
Labor costs rising for Pro customers, shortage of skilled trades.
Uncertain global sourcing environment and tariff impacts.
Integration risk from ADG and FBM acquisitions.
key_opportunities: Acquisition of FBM expands Pro offering and unlocks $250 billion total addressable market for Large Pro.
Cross-selling opportunities between FBM, ADG, and Lowe's stores.
Aging housing stock, $50 billion deferred project demand, 18 million new homes needed by 2033.
Continued momentum in Pro and online sales, My Lowe's Rewards, and new creator network.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Marvin Ellison stated, 'We're confident that our most recent investments and acquisitions will uniquely position us to accelerate sales growth when the market turns.'

evidence.claim: Q2 revenue was $24.0 billion with comparable sales up 1.1%.
evidence.quote: In the second quarter of 2025, we delivered sales of $24.0 billion with comparable sales up 1.1%.

evidence.claim: Adjusted diluted EPS was $4.33, up 5.6% year-over-year.
evidence.quote: we delivered adjusted diluted earnings per share of $4.33, an increase of 5.6% over last year.

evidence.claim: Full-year guidance was updated only to reflect ADG acquisition, not raised organically.
evidence.quote: Today, we are updating our full year 2025 outlook only to reflect the inclusion of ADG. ... Please note that this outlook does not include any potential impacts related to the acquisition of FBM.

evidence.claim: Adjusted gross margin was 33.8%, up 37 basis points.
evidence.quote: Adjusted Gross Margin was 33.8% in the quarter, up 37 basis points from last year with improvements in both Shrink and Credit revenue, as well as continued benefits from our Perpetual Productivity Improvement or PPI initiatives.

evidence.claim: Adjusted operating margin was 14.7%, up 23 basis points.
evidence.quote: Adjusted operating margin rate of 14.7% was up 23 basis points versus prior year.

evidence.claim: Key risks include elevated mortgage rates, cautious consumer, and depressed housing market.
evidence.quote: We're still working through some short-term challenges including elevated mortgage rates, cautious consumer, affordability remains a pressure point that results in the lock-in effect that we've been seeing and also a depressed housing market.

evidence.claim: Key opportunities include FBM acquisition unlocking $250 billion TAM for Large Pro.
evidence.quote: We're now well positioned to not only continue driving growth with our core DIY and small-to-medium Pro customers, but this acquisition also unlocks our ability to serve the Larger Pro within a $250 billion total addressable market.
We're confident that our most recent investments and acquisitions will uniquely position us to accelerate sales growth when the market turns.

evidence.claim: Full-year guidance includes sales range $84.5B-$85.5B, comps flat to up 1%, adjusted operating margin 12.2%-12.3%, adjusted EPS $12.20-$12.45.
evidence.quote: we are now expecting sales in the range of $84.5 billion to $85.5 billion, with comparable sales in a range of flat to up 1%. We also now expect full year adjusted operating margin in a range of 12.2% to 12.3%, and adjusted diluted earnings per share of approximately $12.20 to $12.45.
